verdict.rationale: CDP ships one narrow, built-in event-triggered automation: deposit destinations can act as liquidation addresses. When incoming funds arrive, they are automatically converted to a different asset and credited to the account. Webhooks only deliver event notifications for the user to act on externally, so they are a building block rather than user-defined rules. missing for 10: a general user-definable rule/trigger engine, configurable actions beyond auto-credit/auto-liquidation, conditional logic on arbitrary events, independent corroboration.
